data.name: IntroTitle
data.value: A tour of everything here

data.name: IntroBody
data.value: {0} sample sites and what comes built into them, step by step. Press Next as fast as you like, or Esc to leave.

data.name: ModesTitle
data.value: Launched, or not yet

data.name: ModesBody
data.value: A sample counts as launched once one of its apps is live, and then it links to the stores. Until then, it collects a waitlist.

data.name: ShopOfferTitle
data.value: {0}, a shop that is live

data.name: ShopOfferBody
data.value: It opens with an announcement bar for its in-app code. Close it and it stays closed.

data.name: DemoTitle
data.value: Try the app on the page

data.name: DemoBody
data.value: The hero holds a working product page from the app: pick a pot and a size, and add it to the bag. Every sample has a piece of its app like this one.

data.name: StoresTitle
data.value: One link for every device

data.name: StoresBody
data.value: The badges show only the stores the app is in, and mark the visitor's own device. On a computer, the QR code opens the right store on the phone.

data.name: RatingTitle
data.value: Ratings from the App Store

data.name: RatingBody
data.value: Its App Store listing is read live from Apple and kept on the server for a while: the rating once there are enough of them, the latest version until then.

data.name: FaqTitle
data.value: Answers search engines can read

data.name: FaqBody
data.value: The questions open one answer at a time, and they are marked up so the answers can show in search results.

data.name: ChatTitle
data.value: An assistant that knows the business

data.name: ChatBody
data.value: The tour opened it for you. It answers from {0}'s own facts, in the visitor's language, with a real AI model, and its code downloads only when someone opens it.

data.name: CouponTitle
data.value: A code to copy

data.name: CouponBody
data.value: A first-order code with a copy button, next to the store badges and the QR code at the end of the page.

data.name: CountdownTitle
data.value: {0}, before its launch

data.name: CountdownBody
data.value: A countdown to the morning the app opens, in the visitor's language.

data.name: PreOrderTitle
data.value: Pre-order now, the rest later

data.name: PreOrderBody
data.value: iPhone users can pre-order on the App Store today, and the app downloads by itself on launch day. Android and the web are coming soon.

data.name: OrderTitle
data.value: Build an order

data.name: OrderBody
data.value: Pick a drink, a size and a milk, and the price adds up the way it will in the app.

data.name: InlineChatTitle
data.value: The chat, right on the page

data.name: InlineChatBody
data.value: Here the assistant sits under the hero with suggested questions, so visitors can ask without opening anything.

data.name: WaitlistTitle
data.value: A waitlist that stays clean

data.name: WaitlistBody
data.value: Visitors pick the platforms they want. Every sign-up is confirmed by email, bots are turned away without a word, and one email goes out on launch day.

data.name: CollectTitle
data.value: {0}, click and collect

data.name: CollectBody
data.value: Pick a shop, a day and an hour, and book a collection slot as in the app.

data.name: CardTitle
data.value: A store card in the app

data.name: CardBody
data.value: The Northside Card as members see it: a point for every euro, scanned at the till or added by click and collect.

data.name: PagesTitle
data.value: More than one page

data.name: PagesBody
data.value: Each sample has the pages its business needs, like {0}'s shops on a map with their hours and whether they are open now. Every page has its own title, description and preview image.

data.name: ConciergeTitle
data.value: The chat as a side tab

data.name: ConciergeBody
data.value: The same assistant in its third form: a tab at the edge of the page that opens a panel.

data.name: SessionTitle
data.value: {0}, a session to start

data.name: SessionBody
data.value: Today's session runs right in the hero: start it, skip a move, and watch the lap close.

data.name: LaunchTitle
data.value: Launched one platform at a time

data.name: LaunchBody
data.value: The App Store for iPhone, a waitlist for Android and an install button for the web, all on one page. Installed, each sample opens as an app of its own.

data.name: NewsTitle
data.value: What's new

data.name: NewsBody
data.value: Release notes on the page, linked from the badge in the hero, so returning visitors see what changed.

data.name: LanguagesTitle
data.value: Two languages, both directions

data.name: LanguagesBody
data.value: Every page comes in English and Persian, right to left included, each at its own address. Switch localization off and the site is English only.

data.name: ThemeTitle
data.value: Light and dark

data.name: ThemeBody
data.value: Every sample has a light and a dark look. It follows the device until the visitor picks one, and then it remembers.

data.name: SearchTitle
data.value: Ready for search engines

data.name: SearchBody
data.value: Every page is prerendered, so search engines and visitors get its text before any code runs, along with its canonical link, structured data and a place in the sitemap.

data.name: BoardTitle
data.value: {0}, a pipeline to move

data.name: BoardBody
data.value: Move a deal with its arrows, or focus it and use the arrow keys, and the forecast follows.

data.name: CurrencyTitle
data.value: Prices in three currencies

data.name: CurrencyBody
data.value: Monthly or yearly, in euros, US dollars or pounds, worked out on the page.

data.name: SheetsTitle
data.value: An honest comparison

data.name: SheetsBody
data.value: A page that compares the product with what teams use today, here a spreadsheet, including where the spreadsheet is still the better choice.

data.name: InvoiceTitle
data.value: {0}, an invoice to send

data.name: InvoiceBody
data.value: Change the hours, the rate or the VAT, and the invoice adds itself up, ready to send.

data.name: SavingsTitle
data.value: A calculator with the visitor's numbers

data.name: SavingsBody
data.value: Visitors enter their own numbers and see what a month of admin really costs them.

data.name: DesktopTitle
data.value: Desktop apps too

data.name: DesktopBody
data.value: Next to the stores, a sample can offer a Windows download or the Microsoft Store, and a link to its web app.

data.name: VatTitle
data.value: With or without VAT

data.name: VatBody
data.value: One switch shows every price with or without VAT.

data.name: StayTitle
data.value: {0}, a stay to plan

data.name: StayBody
data.value: Choose dates and a room, and the planner prices the stay the way the app does.

data.name: DirectTitle
data.value: Why book direct

data.name: DirectBody
data.value: The hotel's own reasons to book with it rather than through a booking site.

data.name: RoomsTitle
data.value: Rooms to swipe through

data.name: RoomsBody
data.value: A rooms page with its rates and a gallery that swipes the right way in both languages.

data.name: DeskTitle
data.value: {0}, a front desk that works

data.name: DeskBody
data.value: These previews are not pictures but working pieces of the app, enough to show what it does. Watch two guests get checked in, then mark a room clean yourself.

data.name: CalcTitle
data.value: A price per room

data.name: CalcBody
data.value: Enter the number of rooms and see each plan's price for the month.

data.name: PressTitle
data.value: A press kit

data.name: PressBody
data.value: Logos and pictures for journalists to download, with the facts and the people to quote.

data.name: NotchTitle
data.value: {0}, the smallest page

data.name: NotchBody
data.value: One page with a waitlist and a journal that works: what is left once everything optional is gone.

data.name: RouteTitle
data.value: Where the data goes

data.name: RouteBody
data.value: A privacy promise drawn as a route: the phone, an optional backup, the server, and who never gets anything.

data.name: PrivacyTitle
data.value: Privacy choices

data.name: PrivacyBody
data.value: Errors are reported from the first moment; speed and usage statistics only with consent, and without cookies. Visitors change their choice here at any time.

data.name: LegalTitle
data.value: Legal pages, filled in

data.name: LegalBody
data.value: Privacy, terms, cookies, imprint and accessibility, written for each sample's company. They are samples: have yours checked by a lawyer.

data.name: MissingTitle
data.value: Even the 404

data.name: MissingBody
data.value: A missing address gets a real 404 in the sample's own style and language, with a way back.

data.name: OfflineTitle
data.value: Installs, and opens fast

data.name: OfflineBody
data.value: Each sample installs as an app of its own, and its files are kept for the next visit, while every page still comes fresh from the server.

data.name: LightTitle
data.value: Only what's needed, when it's needed

data.name: LightBody
data.value: Fonts, the chat and this tour download only on the pages and at the moments they are used.

data.name: YoursTitle
data.value: Make it yours

data.name: YoursBody
data.value: bit new creates a project with all {0} samples. Ask your AI agent to make one of them your home page, and it removes the rest.
